findings.claim: Passing named owner-runtime evidence for all 23 required OR-01 through OR-23 scenarios is absent.
findings.observed: The follow-up proof and checkpoint report that the identical owner-runtime command exited 1 with 12 passing and 11 failing tests, positive intake was rejected with 400 SCHEMA_INVALID, and 0/23 matrix rows can be certified at the required approved owner-runtime boundary.
findings.rationale: Goal goal-001 requires reviewable passing automated evidence for every owner-runtime scenario at the required owner-listener and isolated-SQLite boundaries; repository-local supporting totals and a failing aggregate owner run do not establish that gate.

findings.claim: The caller-required TDD proof has no valid matching-command GREEN result.
findings.observed: The manifest declares tddRequired true. The supplied proof preserves a genuine historical RED, but its GREEN section explicitly records BLOCKED, exit 1, with 12 passing and 11 failing tests and states that a passing owner-backed GREEN could not be captured.
findings.rationale: A RED followed by another failing execution does not demonstrate the mandatory failing-then-passing behavioral cycle, regardless of the presence of a GREEN section heading or separate passing repository-local checks.
findings.required: Capture an exit-0 GREEN execution of the exact historical owner command against an approved immutable converged owner checkout while retaining the genuine RED and owner revision/hash provenance.
